definition: Activities that establish or modernise a cloud platform operated for a government or organisation on dedicated or controlled infrastructure. Includes private cloud, government cloud, sovereign cloud platforms, virtualised compute and storage pools, self-service provisioning, orchestration, service catalogues, container platforms, shared platform services, metering, tenant isolation and platform operations. Excludes traditional server virtualisation with no cloud operating characteristics, construction of the underlying datacenter alone, public cloud adoption, and a shared application platform with no compute, platform or cloud service capability.
